assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are documented in the clinical indication
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate transient symptoms with potential arrhythmic events or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring
There is an absence of precertification (CO-197)
The payer has a 30-day retro-auth window
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197 indicating that the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines
The claim cannot be processed for payment at this time
The patient has the right to appeal this determination
The diagnosis codes are R55, I25.10, I34.0
